compatibility: Additive measurements; schema-1 result fields and endpoint comparison are retained.
limitations: Finite fixed candidate pool and one hand-declared target switch.
No router, recurrent brain, policy, environment, reward or biological data is tested.
Zero-initialized newborns contribute no immediate current; dropped records can change current.
Old/new labels conflict on the same inputs without a context cue; their error tradeoff does not measure general forgetting.
Sensitivity scores and support movement do not guarantee improved recovery.

metrics.final_error: New-target MSE after recovery update T, including any structural edit at that update.
metrics.old_target_mse: Evaluation-only MSE at every recovery point; never part of the optimized objective or selection scores.
metrics.old_target_tradeoff: Terminal old-target error and changes from recovery start and trained source. Identical inputs receive incompatible old/new labels, creating a necessary fitting tradeoff; this is not general forgetting or contextual retention evidence.
metrics.paired_difference: Fixed-support minus adaptive for each declared seed; positive favors adaptive. All seeds retained.
metrics.recovery_auc_mean: Trapezoidal new-target MSE area over all recovery points 0..T divided by T updates.
metrics.rewire_mse_delta: Post-rewire minus pre-rewire MSE for the phase's optimized target: source training uses the before-switch target; recovery uses the after-switch target. Both measurements follow optimizer.step and bracket only after_update. Positive means the edit increases that phase's target error.
metrics.tail_mean_error: Mean new-target MSE over the last min(10,T) recovery updates, excluding step 0; tail_update_count records the window size.

randomness.inputs: independent standard normal, float32; 12 observable source features
randomness.pairing: all branches clone one trained source and share identical recovery inputs and evaluation set

scope: Deterministic finite synthetic supervised mechanism probe; not RL performance or biological evidence.

targets.definition: output current = sum(input_feature[pre] * target_edge_coefficient) at each post
targets.loss: mean squared current error over the four outputs
targets.switch: after source training, before intervention and every recovery update
